purpose: Additional measured consumption evidence for the 2025 energy-model audit. Measurements retain their actual dates; none are relabelled as 2025 tests.
conventions: Null means not established from the reviewed source, not zero.
Dates retain the precision provided by the source. Publication date and measurement period are distinct.
dataset_id groups related observations. Combined values, phases, temperature bins and route days are not independent tests.
Raw values and normalized values are retained. Multiplication by 100 is the only conversion from kWh/km.
Relative winter changes have no absolute kWh/100 km equivalent here.
No observation is an automatic acceptance threshold. Vehicle specification, mass, road load, cycle, auxiliaries, conditions and meter boundary must be matched first.

adac_ecotest_2019.summary: BEVs use modified WLTC plus ADAC motorway testing; combustion vehicles use cold/warm WLTC and motorway testing. General protocol specifies 200 kg payload, air conditioning and lights.
adac_ecotest_2019.caution: These are protocol conditions, not individually verified test logs. Published Ecotest results are not interchangeable with plain WLTC predictions. The 2026 protocol is outside this catalog.
